schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Batch every non-major update into a single PR and let it merge itself once CI is green.
Batch GitHub Actions bumps separately, they are cheap to review together.
@nuxt/content only accepts better-sqlite3 ^12 as a peer, so hold the major back until it widens the range.
TypeScript 7 does not resolve against the current tree, and nuxt already vendors its own TypeScript. Revisit when vue-tsc and nuxt ship support.
npm 12 rejects --package-lock-only with EALLOWREMOTE and blocks install scripts, which leaves better-sqlite3 without its native binding. Stay on the 11.x line that can actually resolve this tree.
Majors land one at a time and always by hand.
